_about: GENERATED by src/__tests__/figure_register_export.test.ts from the doors' own declarations (founder rule 11). Hand edits die: the declaration in the code is the only copy.

MK-CF-M-030.label: Each person’s pay
MK-CF-M-030.answers: What everyone in the household earns before anything is taken out.
MK-CF-M-030.formula: gross a year = the sum of every earner’s wage, each annualised from the rhythm they are paid in
inputs: MK-CF-I-002 how often it is paid
decisions: A wage entered for a rhythm is annualised by that rhythm, never by a flat twelve.
MK-CF-M-030.refusal: Shows $0 until a wage is entered; the screen offers the door to enter one.

MK-CF-M-031.label: Take-home
MK-CF-M-031.answers: What actually reaches the bank each month, after federal tax and 401(k) — for one earner, and for the household.
MK-CF-M-031.formula: for one earner: what they entered, or their gross less federal tax less their own 401(k). For the household: the sum of the earners’ figures, never a second calculation.
decisions: Federal income tax only when it is calculated — no Social Security, Medicare or state tax (MK-CF-D-001).
MK-CF-M-031.refusal: Shows $0 until a wage is entered.
MK-CF-M-031.note: ONE figure over two sets: one earner, and the household — so a total and its parts cannot disagree (rule 2). It wears ≈ whenever the figure was calculated rather than entered.

MK-CF-M-032.label: Federal tax bracket
MK-CF-M-032.answers: What the next dollar earned costs in federal income tax.
MK-CF-M-032.formula: the published bracket the household’s gross falls in, for their filing status
decisions: Filing status is assumed to be jointly when two people earn and nobody has said (MK-CF-D-004).
MK-CF-M-032.refusal: The row is not shown until a wage is entered.

MK-CF-M-033.label: Calculated federal tax
MK-CF-M-033.answers: The federal income tax we calculate on the household’s wages, when nobody has entered their own figure.
MK-CF-M-033.formula: tax a month = federal tax on (gross less the standard deduction, at the published bands) ÷ 12
decisions: Assumes the standard deduction, never itemised (MK-CF-D-002).
MK-CF-M-033.refusal: The row appears only when the figure is ours; an entered take-home already has tax inside it.

MK-CF-M-034.label: Your 401(k)s
MK-CF-M-034.answers: What everyone in the household puts into their own 401(k) each month.
MK-CF-M-034.formula: 401(k) a month = the sum of every earner’s own contribution, the employer’s match excluded
decisions: The employer’s match is not counted here — it is not taken out of take-home (MK-CF-D-003).
MK-CF-M-034.refusal: The row is hidden when nobody contributes.

MK-CF-M-035.label: The take-home above is higher than it will really be
MK-CF-M-035.answers: By roughly how much the calculated take-home overstates what will reach the bank, because only federal income tax is taken out of it.
MK-CF-M-035.formula: overstated by = Σ over earners of (Social Security 6.2% of the wage up to the wage base + Medicare 1.45% of the whole wage + 0.9% of the wage above the additional-tax threshold) ÷ 12
decisions: State tax is not in this figure, because we do not know their state (MK-CF-D-005).
MK-CF-M-035.refusal: The warning appears only when the take-home is ours and estimated.

MK-CF-M-036.label: Everything else taken out
MK-CF-M-036.answers: What a payslip takes out beyond the 401(k) — tax, medical cover and anything else bought through work — read back from the figures the person entered.
MK-CF-M-036.formula: for one earner: everything else = (their gross a year − their 401(k) a year − their take-home /year) ÷ 12. For the household: the sum of the earners’ figures, never a second subtraction.
decisions: Shown only when the person entered their own take-home, so the difference is theirs and not ours.
The household figure is the sum of the earners’, so a total and its parts cannot disagree (rule 2).
MK-CF-M-036.refusal: The row is hidden for anyone whose take-home was calculated rather than entered; the household row is hidden unless every earner entered one.
MK-CF-M-036.note: ONE figure over two sets: one earner, and the household. Moved off the screen into this door on 2026-09-14 — the base-pay card used to do the subtraction itself (rule 5).

MK-CF-M-045.label: Social Security takes 6.2% of a wage up to
MK-CF-M-045.answers: The wage ceiling above which no more Social Security tax is taken, named in the warning so the 6.2% can be checked.
MK-CF-M-045.formula: the published wage base for the tax year
decisions: Published figure — the source and the year it applies to are on the master file’s Reference tab (guard D4).
MK-CF-M-045.refusal: Never absent — it is a published figure, not a calculation.

MK-CF-M-046.label: Medicare 1.45% of everything, 0.9% more above
MK-CF-M-046.answers: The wage above which the extra Medicare tax starts, named in the warning so the 0.9% can be checked.
MK-CF-M-046.formula: the published additional-Medicare-tax threshold for the tax year
decisions: Published figure — the source and the year it applies to are on the master file’s Reference tab (guard D4).
MK-CF-M-046.refusal: Never absent — it is a published figure, not a calculation.

MK-CF-M-037.label: Take-home each month
MK-CF-M-037.answers: What reaches the bank in a usual month, from every source of income added together.
MK-CF-M-037.formula: take-home a usual month = Σ of every source’s take-home in a usual month; a source that lands in one month of the year is not spread across twelve
decisions: A once-a-year source keeps its own month and is shown separately, never averaged in.
MK-CF-M-037.refusal: Shows $0 on a fresh account, with the door to enter income — never a dash.

MK-CF-M-038.label: each source of take-home
MK-CF-M-038.answers: What each source of income puts into the bank in a usual month, named and listed.
MK-CF-M-038.formula: one line per source: the earner’s take-home, or the source’s monthly amount
MK-CF-M-038.refusal: The list is replaced by the door to enter income when nothing is entered.

MK-CF-M-039.label: its own month, never spread
MK-CF-M-039.answers: A source that arrives in one month of the year, shown in that month rather than divided by twelve.
MK-CF-M-039.formula: the standout month = the source whose whole year lands in a single month, with that amount and that month
decisions: A lump that lands once is never averaged across the year (founder, 2026-08-28).
MK-CF-M-039.refusal: The line is hidden when no source behaves this way.

MK-CF-M-040.label: is not here — it is reinvested where it is earned
MK-CF-M-040.answers: Income that is taxed but never reaches the bank, so the two totals on this screen can be told apart.
MK-CF-M-040.formula: taxed but not landed = interest and dividends earned inside accounts, which stay where they are earned
MK-CF-M-040.refusal: The sentence is hidden when there is none.

MK-CF-M-041.label: What it is taxed on
MK-CF-M-041.answers: The whole year of income the tax is calculated on — a different number from the take-home, and said to be one.
MK-CF-M-041.formula: gross a year = Σ of every taxable source over the year, wages included at gross
MK-CF-M-041.refusal: Shows $0 on a fresh account, with the door to enter income.

MK-CF-M-042.label: each taxed source
MK-CF-M-042.answers: What each source contributes to the year the tax is calculated on.
MK-CF-M-042.formula: one line per taxable source, at its yearly amount
MK-CF-M-042.refusal: The list is replaced by the door to enter income when nothing is entered.

MK-CF-M-043.label: Federal tax bracket
MK-CF-M-043.answers: What the next dollar costs in federal income tax, with every source counted, not wages alone.
MK-CF-M-043.formula: the published bracket that the whole year’s gross falls in, for their filing status
MK-CF-M-043.refusal: The row is not shown until income is entered.
MK-CF-M-043.note: The same concept as MK-CF-M-032 on the base-pay screen, over a wider base: that one counts wages, this one counts every source. Conflict C-5 on the orchestrator map asks whether they stay two figures.

MK-CF-M-044.label: Calculated federal tax
MK-CF-M-044.answers: The federal income tax for the year, at whichever rate is in force — theirs if they entered one, ours if not.
MK-CF-M-044.formula: tax a year = the rate in force × the year’s gross; when it is ours, federal tax on gross less the standard deduction at the published bands
decisions: When it is ours it assumes the standard deduction and is federal only (MK-CF-D-002).
MK-CF-M-044.refusal: The row is not shown until income is entered.

MK-CF-M-047.label: Expected inflow
MK-CF-M-047.answers: What the plan says comes in this month — take-home, and anything else that lands in this particular month.
MK-CF-M-047.formula: expected inflow = Σ of every income source that lands in this month, at its take-home amount; a source that lands once a year counts only in the month it lands
decisions: A month is a real calendar month, never a twelfth of a year (founder, 2026-08-28).
MK-CF-M-047.grain: one figure per household per month
MK-CF-M-047.refusal: Shows $0 until income is entered, with the door to enter it.

MK-CF-M-048.label: Planned outflow (expenses + debt)
MK-CF-M-048.answers: What the plan says goes out this month — the budget, plus the debt payments due, plus any big bill that falls in this month.
MK-CF-M-048.formula: planned outflow = planned everyday expenses + Σ of the debt payments due this month + Σ of the big bills that fall in this month
decisions: A debt payment is counted as an outflow, not as saving (founder, 2026-06-21).
A bill that falls once a year is shown in its own month, never spread.
MK-CF-M-048.grain: one figure per household per month
MK-CF-M-048.refusal: Shows $0 until expenses or debts are entered.

MK-CF-M-049.label: = Planned surplus
MK-CF-M-049.answers: What the plan leaves over this month, before anything has actually happened.
MK-CF-M-049.formula: planned surplus = expected inflow − planned outflow
MK-CF-M-049.grain: one figure per household per month
MK-CF-M-049.refusal: Shows $0 until both sides are entered.
MK-CF-M-049.note: The Cash flow screen used to subtract this itself (rule 5). It is the door’s figure now.

MK-CF-M-050.label: each planned line
MK-CF-M-050.answers: Each thing the plan says comes in or goes out this month, named, so the two totals can be checked by hand.
MK-CF-M-050.formula: one line per source or commitment that falls in this month, at its amount for this month
MK-CF-M-050.grain: one figure per line per month
MK-CF-M-050.refusal: The list is replaced by the door to enter income or expenses when nothing is entered.

MK-CF-M-051.label: Inflow
MK-CF-M-051.answers: What has actually come in so far this month, as opposed to what the plan expected.
MK-CF-M-051.formula: inflow so far = Σ of the income recorded as received in this month up to today
decisions: Nothing is assumed to have arrived; a source counts only once it is recorded (founder, 2026-08-28).
MK-CF-M-051.grain: one figure per household per month
MK-CF-M-051.refusal: Shows $0 until something is recorded as received.
MK-CF-M-051.note: The words beside it name what is inside it — "Inflow (income (take-home) + rent)" — his cluster 5 ruling of 2026-09-10.

MK-CF-M-052.label: Outflow (expenses + debt)
MK-CF-M-052.answers: What has actually gone out so far this month: the expenses logged, plus the debt payments due in the month.
MK-CF-M-052.formula: outflow so far = expenses logged so far this month + Σ of the debt payments due this month
decisions: Debt payments are counted in full for the month, logged or not, because they are committed.
MK-CF-M-052.grain: one figure per household per month
MK-CF-M-052.refusal: Shows $0 until an expense is logged or a debt is entered.

MK-CF-M-053.label: = Surplus
MK-CF-M-053.answers: What is actually left this month so far — not what the plan said, what has happened.
MK-CF-M-053.formula: surplus so far = inflow so far − outflow so far
MK-CF-M-053.grain: one figure per household per month
MK-CF-M-053.note: The Cash flow screen used to subtract this itself (rule 5). It is the door’s figure now.

MK-CF-M-054.label: each received line
MK-CF-M-054.answers: Each payment recorded as received this month, named, so the inflow total can be checked by hand.
MK-CF-M-054.formula: one line per payment recorded as received in this month, at its amount
MK-CF-M-054.refusal: The list is replaced by the door to record income when nothing is recorded.
